use_jaxtyped_decorator: use the jaxtyped decorator to add runtime type checking to a JAX function
wrap_function_with_jaxtyped: wrap a python function with jaxtyped to enable jaxtyping annotations with typeguard
check_typeguard_version: check the installed typeguard version to decide whether to apply runtime type checking
apply_runtime_type_checking: apply runtime type checking to a function using jaxtyped when typeguard is less than version 3
review_jaxtyped_implementation: review the jaxtyped wrapper to understand how it conditionally applies typeguard type checking
